passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: A good friend can listen, and a good friend can wait.
phrases.ko: 좋은 친구는 들을 수 있고, 기다릴 수도 있어요.
phrases.zh: 好朋友会听，好朋友也会等。
phrases.py: hǎo péng yǒu huì tīng， hǎo péng yǒu yě huì děng。

phrases.en: We share, and we play fair.
phrases.py: wǒ men fēn xiǎng， yě gōng píng de wán。

phrases.en: We are on one team, and we cheer for our team.
phrases.ko: 우리는 한 팀이고, 우리 팀을 응원해요.
phrases.zh: 我们在同一个队，为我们的队加油。
phrases.py: wǒ men zài tóng yī gè duì， wèi wǒ men de duì jiā yóu。

phrases.en: We want to win, but we also want to be fair.
phrases.zh: 我们想赢，可是也想公平。
phrases.py: wǒ men xiǎng yíng， kě shì yě xiǎng gōng píng。

phrases.en: Tom can be kind, and he is my good friend.
phrases.ko: 톰은 친절할 수 있고, 나의 좋은 친구예요.
phrases.zh: 汤姆会很善良，他是我的好朋友。
phrases.py: tāng mǔ huì hěn shàn liáng， tā shì wǒ de hǎo péng yǒu。

phrases.en: He listens when I am sad.
phrases.zh: 我难过的时候，他会听我说。
phrases.py: wǒ nán guò de shí hòu， tā huì tīng wǒ shuō。

phrases.en: He will wait for me at the gate.
phrases.ko: 톰은 교문에서 나를 기다려 줄 거예요.
phrases.py: tā huì zài xiào mén kǒu děng wǒ。

phrases.en: We share a snack after the game.
phrases.zh: 比赛以后我们分享零食。
phrases.py: bǐ sài yǐ hòu wǒ men fēn xiǎng líng shí。

phrases.en: Our team cheers even when we do not win.
phrases.zh: 就算没有赢，我们的队也会加油。
phrases.py: jiù suàn méi yǒu yíng， wǒ men de duì yě huì jiā yóu。

phrases.en: A kind friend makes a good team.
phrases.zh: 善良的朋友能组成好队伍。
phrases.py: shàn liáng de péng yǒu néng zǔ chéng hǎo duì wǔ。

phrases.en: I want to be a good friend too.
phrases.py: wǒ yě xiǎng zuò yí gè hǎo péng yǒu。

full_passage_spoken: A good friend can listen, and a good friend can wait. We share, and we play fair. We are on one team, and we cheer for our team. We want to win, but we also want to be fair. Tom can be kind, and he is my good friend. He listens when I am sad. He will wait for me at the gate. We share a snack after the game. Our team cheers even when we do not win. A kind friend makes a good team. I want to be a good friend too.
full_passage_zh: 好朋友会听，好朋友也会等。我们分享，也公平地玩。我们在同一个队，为我们的队加油。我们想赢，可是也想公平。汤姆会很善良，他是我的好朋友。我难过的时候，他会听我说。他会在校门口等我。比赛以后我们分享零食。就算没有赢，我们的队也会加油。善良的朋友能组成好队伍。我也想做一个好朋友。
